title: Archive through December 19, 2002 - Anonymous (Sunday, September 8, 2002 - 11:37 pm)
content: I began to feel ill at work. I went home and threw up again and then, realized my heart had stopped. That was a strange feeling all by itself. I lost consciousness at 7:15 p.m. I was alone. I found myself out of my body and in a new environment. A dark haired gentleman met me at the door of a very large complex and invited me in. It wasn't a dream. I remember every detail still, 10 months later. He took me through the building and showed me different areas. He showed me a classroom and I saw a few people sitting at desks. He took me to a room filled with ball gowns and he showed me a rack of them that belonged to me. He took me up on a roof and showed me many people out there. I told him I felt great fear in the people. He said they had come from the September 11th incident and they wouldn't come indoors yet. He took me to a room that looked like a lodge kitchen. It had lots of card tables and a stove and cooking area. There was a grand looking Grey haired man making baked goods. I believe he was the head of the lodge or wherever I was. He looked like a fit Santa Claus. He was very loving and smiled at me. He communicated telepathically. He showed me a vision of my ex husband hiding stocks in the sand. Then, I was sent back. I woke up thirteen hours later, still numb from the nose down and unable to get up. I called my friend who is a cardiologist and we took it from there.

arrival.other_being_detail: A dark haired gentleman met the experiencer at the door of a very large complex and invited them in; later a grand-looking grey haired man ("like a fit Santa Claus") was present.

environment.environment_other_detail: Very large complex/building; classroom with desks; room filled with ball gowns (a rack said to belong to the experiencer); roof with many people; lodge-like kitchen with card tables, stove and cooking area.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Vision shown of ex-husband hiding stocks in the sand; mention of people who "had come from the September 11th incident" and would not come indoors yet.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE followed by immediate arrival in a complex with guided tour; no tunnel/light/life review/boundary described; then sent back.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Guided tour of a large complex with specific rooms (classroom; ball gowns said to belong to experiencer; roof area with fearful people said to be from the September 11th incident); telepathic communication from a grand grey-haired "fit Santa Claus"-like man; vision of ex-husband hiding stocks in sand.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “It wasn't a dream. I remember every detail still, 10 months later.”; “He said they had come from the September 11th incident and they wouldn't come indoors yet.”
